categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes version message address handling and peer address management for Tor and I2P connections in net_processing.
categories.rationale: Prevents identity correlation across clearnet and privacy networks by ignoring peer-reported addresses on Tor and I2P connections. While privacy and resistance to deanonymization matter in P2P, the author notes this fingerprint requires specific preconditions: outbound connection to an adversarial privacy peer and a unique custom listening port.
